fields.title: Input column
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Specify namespace
fields.description: If unchecked, no base namespace will be set.

fields.title: Keep type information by adding namespace
fields.description:
When checked, the JSON type information will be preserved, numbers, booleans, ... will be
represented as text, but their node will have a prefix identifying its type. Otherwise all kind
of values will be represented as text.

fields.title: Empty list (https://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/list)
fields.description: Only used for the [] JSON array when the Omit type information is unchecked. Otherwise it is not possible to distinguish between [] and {}.

fields.title: Decimal (https://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/decimal)
fields.description: Prefix for the floating point/decimal values.

fields.title: Root element name
fields.description: There is always a root element, you can specify its name.

fields.title: Array item name
fields.description:
Array items not always can be represented as trees (for example arrays within arrays, or
primitive types within arrays). In this case an XML element with the specified name will be
created for each array entry.

fields.title: Use parent keys as element name for arrays
Use a key to represent values as XML text
fields.description:
When checked, simple values with the specified key will not create attributes, but provide the
single text of the surrounding element.

fields.title: Key for text
fields.description: The key name to represent as XML text

fields.title: Translate JSON keys starting with # to
fields.description:
JSON objects with keys starting with a hash sign such as 
{"#comment": "content"}
can either be translated to XML elements 
<comment
 ns:originalKey="#comment">
  content
</comment>
or to XML comments 
<!--content-->

fields.title: Translate JSON keys starting with ? to
fields.description:
JSON objects with keys starting with a question mark such as 
{"?pi": "content"}
can either be translated to XML elements 
<pi ns:originalKey="?pi">
 content
</pi>
or to XML processing instructions 
<?pi content?>

fields.title: Remove invalid XML characters from values
fields.description: XML 1.0 supports only a limited set of characters (see RFC ). When checked, invalid characters will be removed from values.
